response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile engineer with strong systems and open-source credentials, including relevant geospatial GIS work and some early C/C++ experience, but his recent decade of work is overwhelmingly in TypeScript/Node.js and web/product engineering, with no listed Rust experience and only minimal, dated C++ work (2014-2015). The role requires deep, current C++/Rust expertise plus distributed-systems and routing/navigation pipeline experience, which is not well evidenced here despite the GIS platform being a plausible transferable asset.
strengths: Founder of an open-source Geo-Data/GIS platform (GISCollective), directly relevant domain exposure
Broad, multi-decade engineering background spanning web, mobile, embedded, and systems programming
Demonstrated distributed/high-performance systems experience (Dlang microservices at Sociomantic handling millions of requests/sec)
concerns: No current or recent C++ or Rust experience — last significant C++ work was ~10 years ago at National Instruments
Career trajectory has shifted strongly toward web/product engineering (TypeScript, Node.js) rather than systems/routing pipelines
No explicit experience with navigation guidance systems, routing tile generation, or real-time traffic data integration

key_factors.factor: Lack of recent/deep C++ or Rust experience
Relevant GIS/geospatial domain background via GISCollective
Recent career focus on web/product stack rather than systems programming
